title: Canonical diagonal DNC chart arrows and conormal model
statement:
Use the finite coefficient datum $P$, $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\ge1$ and $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of [def-pur-conventions], its ordinary etale and compared pro-etale derived categories, and the exceptional and derived pullback functors of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. This definition names the following canonical chart arrows and the typing facts needed to form their composites.

For any compactifiable morphism $g:X\to Y$ of schemes, let $u_g:Rg^!\mathbf 1_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}Rg^!A_Y$ be the image under $Rg^!$ of the canonical tensor-unit-to-degree-zero-coefficient comparison, with the target written as the ordinary dualizing object of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object]. For a separated finite-type smooth morphism $h:U\to V$ of pure relative dimension $d\in\mathbf N$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and a finite-type structure map $a_V:V\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, put $W=U\times_VU$, $p_1:W\to U$ and $\Delta:U\to W$. Define $\alpha_h:C(p_1,\Delta)\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_h$ by the fixed inverse smooth base-change mate [lem-pur-diagonal-base-change], pullback composition and section identity, $u_h$, and the canonical finite-coefficient site comparison; $C$ is the section invariant of [def-pur-section-invariant].

Independently of coefficients, let $U,V$ be schemes, $U$ Noetherian, and $h:U\to V$ separated, quasi-compact and smooth of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$. Write $F=\mathcal I_\Delta/\mathcal I_\Delta^2$, the degree-one conormal piece, and $\operatorname{Sym}(F)\to\bigoplus_{r\ge0}\mathcal I_\Delta^r/\mathcal I_\Delta^{r+1}$ for the canonical symmetric comparison of [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra-basic] [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra]. The typing facts are that $F$ is finite locally free of rank $d$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] and this comparison is invertible, including $d=0$. Let $N_\Delta$ be the actual normal cone with its retraction-defined projection $\pi_N$ and zero section $z_N$ [def-pur-normal-bundle], and let $\mathbf V(F)$ have projection $\pi_F$ and zero $z_F$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Define $r_h:N_\Delta\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf V(F)$ by relative Spec of the symmetric comparison composed with the homogeneous-normalized Rees comparison [def-pur-rees-cone-normalization] [lem-pur-rees-cone-normalized-existence]. The model $e_h:\mathbf V(F)\xrightarrow{\sim}N_\Delta$ is selected by the uniquely determining condition $e_h=r_h^{-1}$ together with $\pi_N\circ e_h=\pi_F$ and $e_h\circ z_F=z_N$. The supporting existence-and-uniqueness fact includes these two equations, so no arbitrary normal-bundle automorphism is chosen.

Finally, for Noetherian schemes $W,X,B$, a separated finite-type etale map $e:W\to X$, compactifiable maps $f:X\to B$, $q:W\to B$ with $f\circ e=q$, and maps $s:B\to X$, $s':B\to W$ with $e\circ s'=s$, define the ordinary restriction $C(f,s)\xrightarrow{\sim}C(q,s')$ by the inverse-image composition constraints and the exceptional-adjunction etale-locality mate determined by a graph-normalized compact-support datum [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization]. This is a definition of these maps, not the chart-normalization equality for a diagonal orientation.

lean.statement:
def chartDiagonalAlpha (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (h : U ⟶ V)
    [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d h]
    (aV : V ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aV] [QuasiCompact aV] :
    letI := P.noetherian aV
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P h aV
    Dnc.sourceSection P d (pullback.fst h h) (h ≫ aV) (pullback.diagonal h) ≅
      P.diagonalDualizing h
